findings.statement: PDF p67 explicitly defines 盛德乘时曰旺 and gives 春木旺; p68 gives 冬水旺，水生木则木相. Thus a general seasonal 旺/相 definition is observed, superseding only the earlier missing-definition gap, not closing the temperament mapping.

PDF pp68-69 separately enumerate twelve growth stages including 帝旺 and warn 生旺者未必便作吉论 and 休囚死绝未必便作凶言. The source does not identify current implementation scores or twelve-stage 帝旺 with a universally sufficient temperament antecedent.
PDF p242 introduces 东方震位木 and conditions the quoted disposition on 旺相; it does not explicitly label this wood as the day stem or as the largest total count.
PDF p243 has 参以命中所遇吉凶神煞, conditional 若有煞临 ... 又从煞上断 and 若有克 ... 从所克之五行断, then 日时/纳音. The following 又曰 begins a distinct account using 本五行、不论纳音 and 入格/生旺 conditions.

Based on base-condition and branch-wording: 旺相 is the base paragraph condition; 神煞 is a contextual assessment instruction; 煞临 and 有克 introduce redirection branches; 日时/纳音 is an aggregate assessment basis. 又曰 is not safely a conjunctive premise of the first clause. This is source-local grammatical classification, not an executable rule or proof of contradiction.

A Harvard vol7 witness locator is identifiable through the mirror, but official viewer/catalog requests returned 429 and manifest retrieval returned 403. No primary page was inspected and no mirror-derived copy lineage or physical folio was admitted.
